eventDetail.scope: In the rapidly evolving landscape of education, the integration of data intelligence and educational technology has emerged as a core driver of transformative change. ICET 2026 is committed to exploring and promoting the application of cutting-edge computer technologies to enhance learning efficiency and elevate educational outcomes.  We cordially invite you to participate actively by submitting your papers and abstracts or registering as a delegate. ICET 2026 offers a unique opportunity to engage in face-to-face exchanges with fellow enthusiasts in educational technology, gain frontier insights, and collectively shape the future of education.
